one_month_reasoning: One scheduled event in the window: Q4 FY2026 results Tue 2026-11-17 after the close (Earnings Whispers), with first FY2027 commentary. Base rates: revenue beat the guide midpoint 10/10 quarters (median +2.65% over the last 8) and non-GAAP EPS beat 10/10 (median +7.1%), so a beat (our 3.43 / whisper 3.61 vs guide 3.34-3.40) is expected and largely priced; the post-print reactions have been two-sided (Feb 2026 up ~14% after hours on the guide, Aug 2026 -11.7% for the week despite a big beat on supply-chain caution). The stock just fell 20.8% from Oct 6 to Oct 30 in an AI-hardware de-rating with no company headline; short-horizon reversal after a sharp drop is a small positive. Net: median ~$305 (+0.5%), log sigma 13.5% (annual 45%/3.5 = 12.9% plus a little for the print), roughly symmetric. FOMC (Dec 9-10) falls after the window.

downside.story: 10th percentile: AI-optics test digestion as hyperscaler 800G/1.6T capacity lands and transceiver makers pause tool buys (wireline capture -35%), plus the required China shock (China 17.5% of FY25 revenue, -50% -> ~-8.7% of revenue, spread over wireless -12%, EISG -15%), an industrial/auto soft patch like FY24 (Kalshi 2027 recession 20%), segment margins -4/-5pt toward the FY24-25 levels, and the P/E derating 5 turns to ~17x (the Oct-2023 trough was ~15x trailing non-GAAP). upside.story: 90th percentile: LightCounting's +76% 2027 optics market plus a 3.2T/co-packaged-optics R&D wave lift wireline capture 25%, supply constraints ease so the 1.13 book-to-bill converts, EISG semis/AI +8%, margins +2pt on 50%+ incrementals, and the P/E holds a 4-turn premium (26x) as the market treats AI test as structural.

model_inputs.structure_note: Semis/test playbook: approved quarterly driver build (6 drivers, 100% of revenue driven: CSG = optics market x wl_capture + wireless_rev + adg_rev; EISG = ei_rev; segment margins) valued with (1) a peer-anchored NTM P/E on the build's own non-GAAP EPS at the horizon (FY2028-weighted), weight 0.7, and (2) a mid-cycle normalised-earnings custom leg, weight 0.3 (leg weights are judgment). No DCF (not a neocloud). EBIT basis adjusted (non-GAAP, ex SBC and amortization); SBC handled by the dilution route: net share change -0.8%/yr (buybacks ~$600M/yr less SBC issuance) with the buyback cash out of the net-cash bridge, and the P/E converted from the SBC-expensed peer basis by 0.94. reasoning: Base-rates lane. (1) History: KEYS has had 7 drawdowns of 18%+ since 2014, the deepest after strong years (-45.5% 2015-16; -42.6% Dec-2021 to Oct-2023, 3.9 years underwater, worse than the S&P's -24.5%), and two -20% legs already in 2026 (ChartRow, Trefis). After past +45-58% trailing years the next 12 months were +66% (Mar-2018), +26% (Jan-2019) and -17% (Dec-2021) on our monthly series: momentum is not a reliable guide, cycles are. (2) Cycle: FY24 revenue fell 9% and non-GAAP net margin dropped from 27.3% (FY23) to 22.0% (FY24); FY26 margins (segments 34%/31%) are the highest in the record, so I anchor a 30% leg on a mid-cycle 26% net margin x a through-cycle 22.3x non-GAAP P/E (Macrotrends GAAP median 31.4 x 0.71). (3) Guidance record: 10/10 revenue beats (median +2.65% last 8) and 10/10 EPS beats (median +7.1%); the approved Q4 numbers (1,992 / 3.43) sit at the record-adjusted guide and below the whisper 3.61. (4) Event odds: Kalshi 2027 recession 20% (bid/ask 17/19c, $813K lifetime volume), Polymarket China-Taiwan invasion by mid-2027 6%; these and the required China shock (-50% of the 17.5% China share) shape the fat left tail. (5) Multiple: whole-company peer median 24.2x NTM (6 peers; 4 more segment-only), KEYS 23.2x on the same SBC-expensed basis, k=0.8 -> 23.4x, converted to 22.0x on non-GAAP EPS. The engine values the approved driver set at $355 on the P/E leg; blended research target (12m) $343 (+13%), below the $418 Street average target because of the mid-cycle weight. Downside case $197 (-35% vs spot): optics digestion + China shock + FY24-type margins + 17x; upside case $471 (+55%): optics +25%, margins +2pt, 26x. Spreads are asymmetric (left ln 0.43, right 0.25 per 1.28 sigma) because history says AI-cycle peaks end in long drawdowns. Not driver-linked: the custom mid-cycle leg (stated per share). Research limited: SEC refused direct downloads (used WebFetch), Advantest price stale (Aug 12), no forward EV/EBITDA on one basis.
